output.headline: Provider-focused sponsor with an open platform in the target's own sub-sector, giving a ready add-on route and capacity to pay near the upper quartile.
output.differentiator: Brings an open platform in the target's own sub-sector for an add-on route, backed by 22 of 24 deals in provider services. [A:angles]
output.why_them: Add-on to its open platform; provider specialist sponsor

acquirer_overview.title: Provider specialist sponsor with a EUR 9 billion fund and 24 deals since 2016
points: Financial sponsor; healthcare is one of four core industries. [P:1]
Fund XI closed at its EUR 9 billion hard cap (about $11 billion). [P:2]
24 deals from 2016 to 2024, 21 closed (88%); 22 of 24 in provider services. [T:record, K:closed_share, A:angles]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Natural add-on to Nordic's open platform in the target's sub-sector
points: Open platform in the sub-sector gives an add-on route, and Nordic is a provider specialist. [A:angles]
Platform Build is a motive in 7 of 24 deals, against 23% of all deals in the file. [M:platform_build]
4 deals in the target's own sub-sector and 18 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; sector relatedness and deal count are both modest factors in its favour. [T:record, S:sector_rel, S:activity]

precedent_activity.title: Recent Midwest and same-sub-sector deals show appetite across deal sizes
points: 2024 Principal Physician Group: $76M recapitalization in the Midwest at 15.9x EV/EBITDA. [D:MA-2024-0431]
2023 Harbor Medical Center: $991M leveraged buyout at 11.1x. 2024 Harbor Health Network: $35M carve-out at 11.6x. Both in the target's sub-sector. [D:MA-2023-0466, D:MA-2024-0339]
8 of 24 deals sit in the $100M-$400M comparable size band; 2 were in the Midwest. [K:size_band, T:record]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible; a platform exit gets Nordic past the ask
points: 70 comparable deals: 10.7x EV/EBITDA at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median, 15.3x at the 75th. [V:comps]
Target's 16.8% margin sits above the comps median of 12.9%, supporting the 75th percentile. Nordic's own median paid is 12.5x. [V:comps]
With 5.0x leverage and a $128M equity cheque, return at ask is 18.7% against a 20% target. Maximum price is $193M at the same exit, $216M at a 15.0x platform exit. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Nordic's median deal is $77M, well under the $200M target EV.
risk_flags.mitigant: It has done larger deals and 8 of 24 sit in the comparable size band.
risk_flags.reality: Biggest deal is $1,304M; the size signal is only a slight factor in its favour. [T:record, K:size_band, S:not_smaller]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: Return at ask falls short of Nordic's hurdle.
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts maximum price above the $200M EV.
risk_flags.reality: 18.7% at ask against a 20% target; same-exit maximum is $193M, platform-exit maximum $216M. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Regional footprint
risk_flags.concern: Few past deals are in the Midwest.
risk_flags.mitigant: Principal Physician Group in 2024 was a Midwest deal, and Nordic has bought across many regions.
risk_flags.reality: 2 of 24 deals are in the Midwest; geography is a slight factor against. [K:by_region, D:MA-2024-0431, S:geo_fit]

conviction.rationale: Four own-sub-sector and 18 adjacent provider deals, an open platform for an add-on route, and #2 on the priority list outweigh the size gap, since its median deal of $77M is under half the $200M EV. [C:conviction, R:rank]
